items.prompt: A schedule allocates [4,3,3], but its second target receives no executions. What can the schedule itself establish?

options.text: The intended target quantities, not actual fills.
options.why: Allocation conservation does not prove liquidity, execution or permission to trade.

options.text: A confirmed execution of all 10 shares.
options.why: The schedule contains targets, not venue execution reports.

options.text: An observed market VWAP equal to 10.
options.why: VWAP has price units and requires an eligible execution tape.

options.text: A loss-free trade because every target is balanced.
options.why: Balanced quantities impose no price or profit guarantee.

items.explanation: Allocation conservation does not prove liquidity, execution or permission to trade.
